MP1
CIRCUIT: Ammeter and variable resistor both shown in series with test wire and with correct symbols.
MP2
METHOD MARK 1: Adjust current / variable resistor until wire melts / current stops. Take current reading.
MP3
THE CHOSEN VARIABLE: metal used or diameter
MP4
METHOD MARK 2: Repeat with other metal(s) or other diameter(s)
MP5
VARIABLE TO KEEP CONSTANT: Diameter of wire or metal used, provided it is not the variable chosen for MP3
MP6
TABLE with clear columns for current with unit A and for their chosen variable, with correct unit if appropriate.
MP7
CONCLUSION: Plot graph of current against diameter OR bar chart of current against metal
OR compare the readings to see if the chosen variable affects the current at which the fuse wire melts
